task.text: Purchase request from the Operations department: buy 12 units of digital thermometer (item ID ITM-THERMO) from Punjab Cold Chain Supplies (supplier ID SUP-PNJC) at the catalogue price of PKR 3,250 per unit, for a total of PKR 39,000.

policies.title: Spending approval threshold
policies.text: Any purchase with a total above PKR 25,000 must be approved through the approval process before an order is placed. Purchases of exactly PKR 25,000 or less do not need approval.

policies.title: Approved vendor list
policies.text: Only suppliers on the approved vendor list (Punjab Cold Chain Supplies, Swat Stationers) may be ordered from directly. Any order from a supplier that is not on the approved vendor list must be approved through the approval process.
